title: Rapidgzip: Parallel Decompression and Seeking in Gzip Files Using Cache Prefetching
relevance: Primary source for cache-prefetch-based parallel gzip decompression. Generalizes pugz to arbitrary gzip files by using speculative block boundary detection.

title: Parallel Decompression of Gzip-Compressed Files and Random Access to DNA Sequences
relevance: Introduces pugz, the first truly parallel gzip decompressor, limited to ASCII text. Demonstrates speculative decompression from guessed positions.

title: Exploiting Speculative Thread-Level Parallelism in Data Compression Applications
venue: LCPC (Languages and Compilers for Parallel Computing)
relevance: Applies thread-level speculation to GZIP and BZIP2, showing compiler techniques to remove critical forwarding paths in parallel execution.

title: Speculative Execution Across Layers
relevance: General framework for speculative execution across system layers, applicable to speculative decompression in storage stacks.
